items.t: Chilliwack is in the Fraser Valley Regional District; its 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw No. 5500, uses B2 Chilliwack Proper, B3 Downtown, B5 Sardis, B7 Yarrow.
Highway 1 crosses the north side; houses south of the Vedder River sit in the B5 Sardis plan area.
R1-A (Urban Residential): minimum lot 500 square metres, width 15 metres; R1-C: 300 interior, 360 corner; R3 small-lot: 360.
HR (Hillside Residential): minimum 0.2 hectares with community water; AL (Agricultural Lowland): 7.5 hectares.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Zoning bylaw: Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, verified fresh on the City site.

Small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH): City guide (July 2025) — up to four units on lots over 280 square metres inside the urban growth boundary, about 11,000 properties; no new suites below the flood construction level.
Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519: floor elevation equals flood construction level plus 0.6 metres freeboard.
Subdividing needs an application decided by the Approving Officer; hillside means slopes of 20 percent or more, with added standards.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Curbside collection changed May 1, 2026: compost weekly; garbage and recycling alternate bi-weekly.
Promontory, Ryder Lake, Eastern Hillsides and Little Mountain are Wildlife Issue Areas: no carts out before 5:00 a.m.
Chilliwack General Hospital: 45600 Menholm Road; Urgent and Primary Care Centre: #104, 7955 Evans Road.
SD33 enrolment is at 103 percent of capacity, Cheam Elementary at 217 percent; catchments may change for September 2027.
Chilliwack Library is at 45860 First Avenue, beside Salish Park (Fraser Valley Regional Library).

blocks.text: Chilliwack Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Provincial Housing Target Order: 4,594 homes by June 30, 2029; Year 2 report — 1,781 delivered vs 1,404 target. STATUS: in progress, read 2026-11-03.
New East Side Elementary School, 10125 McGrath Road: 500-seat school, Province with SD33. STATUS: construction; opening September 2027, read 2026-11-03.
Highway 1: widening under construction west of Abbotsford; Chilliwack segment at study stage (Province, September 2026). STATUS: planning, read 2026-11-03.
Andmar: see sardis-condos-for-sale. Keith Wilson: see sardis-townhomes-for-sale. Promontory school: see sardis-houses-for-sale.
2026 residential rate: municipal 3.00943 per $1,000 assessed; total 4.66727 per $1,000, plus drainage 0.12024 per $1,000 on land only.
2026 water/sewer flat rate (20-millimetre connection, three months): water $33.99, sewer $55.18; metered $2.00 / $4.09 per 100 cubic feet.
Solid waste billed quarterly under Solid Waste Management Bylaw 2026, No. 5541.
Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies: the Province lists Chilliwack as a taxable area.
BC Transit, not TransLink, runs Chilliwack transit; Downtown is the exchange for routes 51–59, 71, 72.
Route 66 Fraser Valley Express: Downtown Chilliwack to Lougheed Town Centre Station, via Vedder/Luckakuck and Lickman Park & Ride.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Bylaw No. 4519 setbacks: 60 metres Fraser River, 75 metres Vedder River, 30 metres Chilliwack River and Vedder Canal.
Hillside lots: Development Permit Areas 2 and 5 require a geotechnical report; riparian: Area 3.
Off-sewer houses need an onsite system under the Sewerage System Regulation (Fraser Health); wells: GWELLS registry.

faq.a: Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) rules limit most parcels to one residence unless another qualifies; a principal residence must be 500 square metres or less, with any suite inside it. Check the parcel on Agricultural Land Commission mapping before assuming a second home is possible.
